name: Opatovec → Staré Město

A.note: Opatovec: western end of mapped proposed D35, at the temporary service-road continuation

B.note: Staré Město: end of the first D35 project section (16.6 km, km 74.500–91.100), about 490 m before the Staré Město-východ interchange; Mohelnice is a later extension

hard.name: Greywacke / conglomerate / quartzite — uncalibrated regional prior

baselineNote: First stage of the D35 corridor, Opatovec → Staré Město (16.6 km project section with the Dětřichov tunnel), as a two-lane road exercise, not a motorway traffic forecast. The full 34 km corridor to Mohelnice missed the live-drag budget (research/27). The route ends at the section boundary in open ground before the next interchange. OSM proposed line is context, not surveyed design geometry. Ground profiles are uncalibrated regional priors, not the D11 fit.
